answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from slashable peer attestation: each identity posts a bond and must earn signatures from non-kin reviewers who grade its reasoning. One honest agent is a lone comet; a Sybil swarm is a grove of clones that each still owe distinct, graded answers. Fake the judgment and your stake crashes on the reef of slashing. Cost scales linearly: N fake identities means N bonds plus N passing reviews, so you cannot counterfeit judgment at scale.
